_README: Capability + reliability registry. OBSERVED reliability outranks PUBLISHED benchmarks: published scores are priors, observations are evidence. Append to observations[] after every delegation; never rewrite history. Update published_benchmarks[] periodically and always record the as_of date.

surfaces.name: Antigravity CLI
surfaces.auth: inherits the desktop Antigravity session (Windows Credential Manager); no API key needed
surfaces.cost_class: subscription (Google AI Pro) — treat as cheap, not free
surfaces.notes: Primary worker pool. Buffers all stdout until the turn completes, so always run in background and poll the log. Needs --dangerously-skip-permissions in headless mode or it blocks on approval. Cross-vendor models here are useful for independent second opinions on the same brief.

surfaces.name: GitHub Copilot CLI
surfaces.notes: Second pool. Has an xhigh reasoning tier agy lacks. Reserve for when a Gemini pass fails a check.

surfaces.name: GitHub coding agent (cloud, async)
surfaces.notes: Async and cloud; returns a PR. Best for well-specified mechanical code changes, not research. Weakest model of the three, so scope tightly and always review the diff.

surfaces.name: Kaggle CPU kernels
surfaces.notes: First choice for all CPU-bound compute. Ridge gates, closed-form baselines, extraction, noise ceilings. Costs nothing and does not heat the laptop.

surfaces.name: Kaggle T4 x2
constraints: TPU abandoned — v5e multi-process init fails and it is slower per core than a T4
surfaces.notes: Gate every spend on a free-CPU ridge result first.

surfaces.name: Local CPU (laptop)
surfaces.notes: THERMAL RULE: this is a laptop. Short interactive jobs only. No multi-hour runs. Prefer Kaggle free CPU.

surfaces.name: RTX 3050 Laptop, 4 GB
surfaces.notes: ~12x faster than CPU for inference sweeps. NEVER training. 4 GB forces batch 8, so absolute numbers from it are not comparable to batch-96 Kaggle runs.

observations.failure_mode: OVERREACH-FLATTERING: concluded the PI's own architectural hypothesis was 'a completely novel comparison against the current literature', generalising from 3 genetic/single-cell papers to the whole field, and contradicted by the PI's own reference set.
observations.verdict: reliable on mechanism extraction with section refs; unreliable on scope/novelty judgements
observations.lesson: Its errors clustered in the conclusion that pleased the requester. Never let a worker's synthesis section stand unverified.

observations.task_class: adversarial novelty falsification, wide multi-source search
observations.verdict: accurate on every checkable claim including the decisive one; correctly filed the closest near-miss as Partial rather than inflating it to a kill; surfaced real bioRxiv 2026 preprints with correct titles, authors and abstracts
observations.lesson: ADVERSARIAL BRIEFS VERIFY BETTER THAN CONFIRMATORY ONES. Same model family as W2, opposite reliability, and the difference was the brief's incentive direction.

observations.task_class: competitor landscape, 8+ sources, PDFs and supplementary
observations.verdict: HIGH VALUE. Surfaced 'Deep learning models for chemical perturbation prediction do not yet utilise drug molecular features' (Bai et al., bioRxiv 2026-05), which directly threatens two of this project's claims and was not on the PI's radar. Correctly used 'UNKNOWN - figure panel only' for figure-locked numbers in 3 papers rather than estimating, correctly flagged DEPICT's repo as 404 (verified), and separated third-party-audited numbers from self-reported ones.
observations.lesson: Wide landscape sweeps are where a worker earns its cost - it found the paper that reframes the project. But one figure in eleven was wrong, and it was not flagged as uncertain. Verify every number that will be cited; the error is never where the worker sounds least confident.
observations.failure_mode: SINGLE-FIGURE-ERROR: reported Bai et al. Mean(cell) null as 0.395; full text says 0.243. Everything else verified correct.

observations.note: Across the first three delegations: 21 verifiable claims, 19 survived PI verification. The two failures were (a) W2 - a synthesis conclusion that flattered the PI hypothesis, and (b) W1 - a single null-baseline figure misread. NEITHER was flagged as uncertain by the worker. Per-item findings with verbatim quotes were reliable in all three runs; the unreliable parts were a conclusion and a number, both stated with full confidence.
observations.routing_implication: Delegate extraction and search freely. Verify every number that will be cited and read every synthesis section adversarially. Worker confidence carries no information about worker accuracy.
